message.content: No, Li Hua did not inquire about placing potted plants in the basement before she raised the topic of decorating the basement. In the record, Li Hua first asked Adam Smith if she could add some sound-insulating pads to the basement, which he was open to if it was reversible and didn't damage anything. After receiving approval, she mentioned her intention to decorate the basement, specifically asking for his opinion on adding sound-insulating pads. There is no mention of potted plants being discussed prior to this request.
